list: Your notifications from the last 90 days.
read_all: Done, your notifications are marked as read.
preferences_updated: Done, your notification preferences were saved.

assignee_duty.owner: You answer for this control and review the evidence your team uploads.
assignee_duty.executor: You carry out this control: you upload the evidence its tests ask for.

digest.subject: Monkey · You have {count} new notifications ({date})
digest.heading: You have {count} new notifications
digest.preheader: Your daily Monkey summary: what is still unread.
digest.intro: This is your daily Monkey summary. Here is what you have not read yet:
digest.footnote: You get this summary once a day while you have unread notifications. To turn it off, disable the email summary in your notification preferences; notifications inside Monkey keep arriving as usual.

window_due_soon.title: {control_code} · The {periodicity} window closes on {due_date} and evidence is missing
window_due_soon.what_happened: Control {control_label} in the service {service_name} has no valid evidence in the {periodicity} window that closes on {due_date}.
window_due_soon.why_it_matters: If the window closes without evidence, the requirement becomes Expired and the control goes back to Non-compliant.
window_due_soon.how_to_fix: Upload the evidence from the control detail and ask for its review.
window_due_soon.evidence: What the control's tests ask for in the current window.
window_due_soon.impact: With the evidence on time, the control keeps its level in the audited period.

grouped.title: {control_count} unassigned controls have windows closing soon
grouped.title_one: 1 unassigned control has a window closing soon
grouped.what_happened: In the service {service_name}, the early warning of the window arrived today for these unassigned controls with no valid evidence: {control_list}.
grouped.why_it_matters: If a window closes without evidence, the requirement becomes Expired and the control goes back to Non-compliant.
grouped.how_to_fix: Open the service's control list filtered by Unassigned, give each an owner and ask for the evidence.
grouped.who: Nobody: these controls have no owner. You get this notice as a company administrator.
grouped.time_needed: Each control has its own closing date: check which one expires first.
grouped.evidence: What each control's tests ask for in its current window.
grouped.impact: With an owner and evidence on time, the controls keep their level in the audited period.

window_expired.title: {control_code} · The {periodicity} window closed on {due_date} without evidence
window_expired.what_happened: The {periodicity} window of control {control_label} in the service {service_name} closed on {due_date} without valid evidence.
window_expired.why_it_matters: The requirement becomes Expired and the control goes back to Non-compliant.
window_expired.how_to_fix: Upload current evidence from the control detail and ask for its review for the window in progress.
window_expired.time_needed: The window closed on {due_date}. Evidence for the window in progress can be uploaded today.
window_expired.evidence: What the control's tests ask for in the window in progress.
window_expired.impact: The audited period is left with a window without evidence and the control drops a level.

grouped.title: {control_count} unassigned controls have expired windows
grouped.title_one: 1 unassigned control has an expired window
grouped.what_happened: In the service {service_name}, the window of these unassigned controls closed yesterday without valid evidence: {control_list}.
grouped.why_it_matters: The requirement becomes Expired and the control goes back to Non-compliant.
grouped.how_to_fix: Open the service's control list filtered by Unassigned, give each an owner and ask for the evidence of the window in progress.
grouped.who: Nobody: these controls have no owner. You get this notice as a company administrator.
grouped.time_needed: Evidence for the window in progress can be uploaded today.
grouped.evidence: What each control's tests ask for in the window in progress.
grouped.impact: The audited period is left with a window without evidence and each control drops a level.

control_assigned.title: {control_code} · You were assigned this control as {assignee_role}
control_assigned.what_happened: {actor} assigned you control {control_label} in the service {service_name} as {assignee_role}.
control_assigned.how_to_fix: Open the control and review its tests and the evidence it is missing.
control_assigned.time_needed: The control's evidence windows follow its periodicity; check which one closes first.
control_assigned.evidence: What the control's tests ask for.
control_assigned.impact: The control measures compliance of the service {service_name}: without current evidence, its level drops.

evidence_approved.title: {control_code} · A piece of evidence was approved
evidence_approved.what_happened: {actor} approved a piece of evidence of control {control_label} in the service {service_name}.
evidence_approved.why_it_matters: Approved evidence counts toward the control's compliance in its window.
evidence_approved.how_to_fix: You do not need to do anything: open the control if you want to see how its state changed.
evidence_approved.time_needed: The submission is already approved: no deadline is pending for it.
evidence_approved.evidence: The submission you uploaded or that was uploaded to your control.
evidence_approved.impact: If other tests of the control still lack valid evidence, the control stays pending.

evidence_rejected.title: {control_code} · A piece of evidence was rejected
evidence_rejected.what_happened: {actor} rejected a piece of evidence of control {control_label} in the service {service_name}.
evidence_rejected.why_it_matters: Rejected evidence does not count: the test still has no valid evidence and the control does not move forward.
evidence_rejected.how_to_fix: Open the control, read the reason for the rejection and upload a corrected version.
evidence_rejected.time_needed: Upload the correction before the test's window closes.
evidence_rejected.evidence: A new version of the rejected submission, fixing what the review pointed out.
evidence_rejected.impact: Until there is an approved version, the window may close without evidence and the control may drop a level.

observation_created.title: {control_code} · The auditor left an observation
observation_created.what_happened: The auditor left an observation on control {control_label} in the service {service_name}.
observation_created.why_it_matters: An open observation asks the company for an answer.
observation_created.how_to_fix: Open the control, read the observation and answer it.
observation_created.time_needed: Answer while the audited period is still open.
observation_created.evidence: Whatever supports your answer, if needed.
observation_created.impact: The auditor closes it when the answer is enough.

direct_check_failed.title: {control_code} · An automated check of the control started failing
direct_check_failed.what_happened: In control {control_label} of the service {service_name}, {failure_count} automated checks started failing: {failure_list}.
direct_check_failed.why_it_matters: While the check keeps failing, the control goes back to Non-compliant.
direct_check_failed.how_to_fix: Open the control and fix what each check points out; the next automatic reading measures it again.
direct_check_failed.time_needed: The next automatic reading confirms the fix.
direct_check_failed.evidence: The new result of the check: nothing needs to be uploaded.
direct_check_failed.impact: Once the check passes, the control recovers its level.

check_parameters_changed.title: An evaluation parameter changed: {parameter_name}
check_parameters_changed.what_happened: Monkey changed the parameter {parameter_name}: the previous value was {previous_value} and the new one is {new_value}.
check_parameters_changed.how_to_fix: You do not need to do anything: review the controls of your services if you notice a change in their status.
check_parameters_changed.who: Changed by Monkey; you receive it as an administrator of the company.
check_parameters_changed.time_needed: It applies from the next evaluation of each service.
check_parameters_changed.evidence: Nothing needs to be uploaded: the change applies to what is already measured.
check_parameters_changed.impact: The controls of your services are evaluated with the new value; their status may change without your evidence changing.

automatic_evidence_stale.title: {control_code} · The automated evidence of the control is out of date
automatic_evidence_stale.what_happened: The latest automatic reading of {stale_count} assets of control {control_label} in the service {service_name} is older than allowed: {stale_list}.
automatic_evidence_stale.why_it_matters: Out-of-date evidence leaves the test pending until there is a new reading.
automatic_evidence_stale.how_to_fix: A new reading of the asset fixes it: check that its connection is still active and request an evaluation.
automatic_evidence_stale.time_needed: It is fixed by the next automatic reading of the asset.
automatic_evidence_stale.impact: With the new reading, the test is measured again.

control_pending_approval.title: {control_code} · A control is waiting for your approval
control_pending_approval.what_happened: Control {control_label} in the service {service_name} complies and is waiting for your approval.
control_pending_approval.why_it_matters: A control only counts as compliant once it is approved.
control_pending_approval.how_to_fix: Open the control, review its evidence and approve it or send it back.
control_pending_approval.time_needed: Approve it while the evidence is still current.
control_pending_approval.impact: Once approved, the control moves on to the administrator's final approval.

control_owner_approved.title: {control_code} · The responsible person approved a control
control_owner_approved.what_happened: The responsible person approved control {control_label} in the service {service_name}.
control_owner_approved.why_it_matters: The final approval is still needed for it to count as compliant.
control_owner_approved.how_to_fix: Open the control, review its evidence and give it the final approval.
control_owner_approved.time_needed: Approve it while the evidence is still current.
control_owner_approved.impact: With the final approval, the control counts as compliant.

control_returned.title: {control_code} · A control was sent back
control_returned.what_happened: Control {control_label} in the service {service_name} was sent back for handling.
control_returned.why_it_matters: A control that was sent back does not count as compliant until it is fixed and approved again.
control_returned.how_to_fix: Open the control, read the reason it was sent back and fix what is missing.
control_returned.time_needed: Fix it before its evidence window closes.
control_returned.evidence: What fixes the issue pointed out when it was sent back.
control_returned.impact: Once fixed and approved, the control counts again.

document_assigned.title: You were assigned the document {document_name}
document_assigned.what_happened: You were assigned the document {document_name} to read and accept.
document_assigned.why_it_matters: Accepting the document records that you know it.
document_assigned.how_to_fix: Open it, read it and accept it.
document_assigned.time_needed: Reading and accepting it takes a few minutes.
document_assigned.evidence: Your acceptance is recorded with the version you read.
document_assigned.impact: The company needs every assigned person to accept it.

document_acceptance_reminder.title: You still have to accept the document {document_name}
document_acceptance_reminder.what_happened: You have not accepted the document {document_name} yet.
document_acceptance_reminder.why_it_matters: The company needs your acceptance to consider the document known.
document_acceptance_reminder.how_to_fix: Open it, read it and accept it.
document_acceptance_reminder.time_needed: Reading and accepting it takes a few minutes.
document_acceptance_reminder.evidence: Your acceptance is recorded with the version you read.
document_acceptance_reminder.impact: Until you accept it, the document is not accepted by everyone assigned.

document_approval_requested.title: A document is waiting for your approval: {document_name}
document_approval_requested.what_happened: The document {document_name} is waiting for your approval.
document_approval_requested.why_it_matters: The document is only in force once every step approves it.
document_approval_requested.how_to_fix: Open it, review it and approve it or reject it with the reason.
document_approval_requested.time_needed: Reviewing it takes as long as reading it.
document_approval_requested.evidence: Your decision is recorded with the version you reviewed.
document_approval_requested.impact: Until it is approved, the document is not in force.

document_renewal_due.title: The document {document_name} has to be renewed
document_renewal_due.what_happened: The document {document_name} is about to be due for renewal.
document_renewal_due.why_it_matters: An expired document stops counting as evidence.
document_renewal_due.how_to_fix: Create the new version and send it for approval.
document_renewal_due.time_needed: Renewing it on time keeps it from expiring.
document_renewal_due.evidence: The new version of the document.
document_renewal_due.impact: Renewed on time, the document stays in force.

company_purge_upcoming.title: The company {company_name} will be deleted soon
company_purge_upcoming.what_happened: The archived company {company_name} will be permanently deleted in a few days.
company_purge_upcoming.why_it_matters: The permanent deletion cannot be undone.
company_purge_upcoming.how_to_fix: If it must not be deleted, reactivate it before the deadline.
company_purge_upcoming.time_needed: A few days are left until the deadline.
company_purge_upcoming.impact: After the deadline, the company and its data are removed.

level_override_proposed.title: {control_code} · The owner proposes a level correction
level_override_proposed.what_happened: The owner proposed a final level different from the suggested one for control {control_label} of service {service_name}.
level_override_proposed.why_it_matters: Until you decide, the control keeps the level Monkey calculated.
level_override_proposed.how_to_fix: Open the control, read the justification and approve or reject it.
level_override_proposed.impact: Once approved, the final level replaces the suggested one.

level_override_decided.title: {control_code} · Your level proposal was decided
level_override_decided.what_happened: The administrator decided your level proposal for control {control_label} of service {service_name}.
level_override_decided.why_it_matters: The level in force decides whether the control complies.
level_override_decided.how_to_fix: Open the control and see the decision and its reason.
level_override_decided.impact: Once approved, the final level replaces the suggested one everywhere.

remediation_plan_proposed.title: {control_code} · A remediation plan awaits your decision
remediation_plan_proposed.what_happened: The owner registered a remediation plan for control {control_label} of service {service_name}.
remediation_plan_proposed.why_it_matters: Without an approved plan for each exception, the control cannot reach Partial.
remediation_plan_proposed.how_to_fix: Open the control, read what will be done, by whom and by when, and approve or reject it.
remediation_plan_proposed.time_needed: Decide soon: the control stays at Weak until it is approved.
remediation_plan_proposed.evidence: The plan: what, who and by when.
remediation_plan_proposed.impact: Once approved, the plan counts toward the Partial level.

remediation_plan_decided.title: {control_code} · A remediation plan was decided
remediation_plan_decided.what_happened: The administrator decided the remediation plan of control {control_label} of service {service_name}.
remediation_plan_decided.why_it_matters: An approved plan allows the Partial level; a rejected one is registered again.
remediation_plan_decided.how_to_fix: Open the control and see the decision. If the plan was assigned to you, do it by the agreed date.
remediation_plan_decided.who: Decided by: administrator · Does it: the person in the plan
remediation_plan_decided.impact: Once approved, the plan counts toward the Partial level.

not_applicable_requested.title: {control_code} · A “Not applicable” awaits your decision
not_applicable_requested.what_happened: The owner asked to mark a requirement as “Not applicable” in control {control_label} of service {service_name}.
not_applicable_requested.why_it_matters: A requirement that does not apply leaves the control’s calculation.
not_applicable_requested.how_to_fix: Open the control, read the justification and approve or reject it.
not_applicable_requested.time_needed: Decide soon: it changes the control’s progress.
not_applicable_requested.impact: Once approved, the requirement leaves the control’s percentage.

not_applicable_decided.title: {control_code} · Your “Not applicable” was decided
not_applicable_decided.what_happened: The administrator decided the “Not applicable” you asked for in control {control_label} of service {service_name}.
not_applicable_decided.why_it_matters: A requirement that does not apply leaves the control’s calculation.
not_applicable_decided.how_to_fix: Open the control and see the decision and its reason.
not_applicable_decided.impact: Once approved, the requirement leaves the control’s percentage.
